description: Ottomatt Security Audit Immutable Rubric (Autoresearch: prepare.py equivalent). Defines HOW findings are scored. MUST NOT be modified during an audit run.

regressionGate.description: PR blocked if score drops more than this many points from baseline

severityDefinitions.CRITICAL: Exploitable now with public tools. Data breach or full system compromise.
severityDefinitions.HIGH: Exploitable with moderate effort. Privilege escalation or significant data exposure.
severityDefinitions.MEDIUM: Requires specific conditions. Limited data exposure or defense-in-depth gap.
severityDefinitions.LOW: Informational or best-practice deviation. No direct exploitability.

deltaTracking.description: Each finding compared against prior audit to track improvement
